subject.title: feat: announce critical session health beyond the rail and teach companion delegation

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this broader critical-session observer announcement and webchat-specific delegation guidance as the Control UI’s supported operator-attention model?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes operator notification scope and agent behavior rather than repairing a documented regression; the protected maintainer label signals that product ownership should confirm this direction.

options.title: Sponsor the notification model
options.body: Confirm critical background-session notices and companion-first status guidance as supported Control UI behavior, then complete contract and proof review before merge.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Keep only the gateway or UI portion that maintainers want, and remove the remaining product-policy behavior from this PR.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Defer the attention model until its desired notification, persistence, and agent-guidance policy is explicitly designed.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the notification model
recommendation.body: Confirm critical background-session notices and companion-first status guidance as supported Control UI behavior, then complete contract and proof review before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available PR history identifies this person as the only evidenced owner of the proposed cross-surface behavior; current-main ownership could not be inspected.
